paragraphs.text: Pixie Queen is an obsolete creature type for cards that represented queens of the pixies .

Pixie Queen debuted as a creature type in Legends on the eponymous named Pixie Queen . In the Grand Creature Type Update it was given errata to instead be Faerie . Pixie Queens appears to be a light skinned faerie with green hair, large green eyes, green lips, and large green wings. They wield a scepter with a crystal on top.
